description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useTicTacToe' that manages state and game logic for a Tic Tac Toe game, including board state, player turns, winner determination, draw detection, and actions such as play, reset, and set starting player.

methods.name: useTicTacToe(initialStarter = 'X')
methods.description: Custom React hook managing the state and logic of a Tic Tac Toe game, including board state, turn management, winner and draw detection, and control actions.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the game state to start a new game with an optional starter ('X' or 'O').

methods.name: setStarter
methods.description: Sets which player ('X' or 'O') will start the game.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Handles a move by the current player at a specified index on the board.
